name: tutorhero-mcp
description: TutorHero Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool schema for agentic skills discovery, ELO benchmarks, and pairwise comparisons across 300 repositories.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Fetches complete telemetry, verified architecture, token efficiency, and benchmark ELO for any of the 300 skills in TutorHero.

id.description: Unique identifier of the skill or repository (e.g. 'vllm', 'claude-code', 'qdrant')

tools.name: compare_skills
tools.description: Performs statistical head-to-head comparison between two repositories: delta ELO, speed multiple, token reduction, and web traffic.

tools.name: list_top10
tools.description: Returns dynamic Top 10 leaderboards filtered by domain category (coding, inference, rag, audio, reasoning).

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Executes semantic and keyword search across all 300 skills, tags, architectures, and primary use cases.

query.description: Keywords or capability to search for

tools.name: get_adoption_pulse
tools.description: Retrieves aggregate 7-day ecosystem star trajectory, median growth velocity, and breakout repos of the week.
